About.title: About
About.body: Frontend Developer with experience in <highlight>React, Next.js, and TypeScript</highlight>, focused on building modern, product-driven web applications. I have contributed to the development of <underline>analytics dashboards</underline> and the integration of external APIs and third-party services, including payment gateways such as <highlight>Stripe and NMI</highlight>. I have experience making <underline>frontend architecture decisions</underline>, defining rendering strategies with Next.js (CSR, SSR, and SSG), and automating build and deployment pipelines on <highlight>Vercel</highlight> to improve the scalability, performance, and maintainability of applications in production.

highlights.1: Develop, maintain, and evolve modern web applications using Next.js, React, and TypeScript, ensuring scalability, performance, and technical quality
highlights.2: Integrate payment gateways such as Stripe and NMI for secure transaction processing, subscriptions, and custom checkout flows
highlights.3: Implement and automate build and deployment pipelines on Vercel, improving delivery speed and reducing production environment errors
highlights.4: Participate in frontend architecture decisions and define best practices to improve maintainability and scalability across the codebase

highlights.1: Developed and maintained web applications using React.js and related frontend technologies
highlights.2: Implemented responsive designs and ensured cross-browser compatibility across supported devices
highlights.3: Participated in code reviews to improve quality, readability, and consistency across the codebase
